accounts_login_check.name: accounts_login_check
accounts_login_check.value: "accounts"."login_enabled" IN (0, 1) AND ("accounts"."login_enabled" = 0 OR ("accounts"."password_hash" IS NOT NULL AND length("accounts"."password_hash") > 0)) AND "accounts"."session_version" > 0

availability_slots_range_check.name: availability_slots_range_check
availability_slots_range_check.value: "availability_slots"."day_of_week" BETWEEN 0 AND 6 AND "availability_slots"."start_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439 AND "availability_slots"."end_minute" BETWEEN 1 AND 1440 AND "availability_slots"."start_minute" < "availability_slots"."end_minute" AND "availability_slots"."preference" IN ('preferred', 'unavailable')

location_settings_schedule_check.name: location_settings_schedule_check
location_settings_schedule_check.value: "location_settings"."schedule_start_hour" BETWEEN 0 AND 23 AND "location_settings"."schedule_end_hour" BETWEEN 1 AND 24 AND "location_settings"."schedule_start_hour" < "location_settings"."schedule_end_hour"

location_settings_timing_check.name: location_settings_timing_check
location_settings_timing_check.value: "location_settings"."late_minutes" BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND "location_settings"."early_clock_in_minutes" BETWEEN 0 AND 120 AND "location_settings"."no_show_minutes" BETWEEN 0 AND 120 AND "location_settings"."automatic_clock_out_minutes" BETWEEN 1 AND 1440 AND "location_settings"."meal_break_after_hours" BETWEEN 1 AND 24

pto_requests_values_check.name: pto_requests_values_check
pto_requests_values_check.value: "pto_requests"."compensation" IN ('paid', 'unpaid') AND "pto_requests"."reason" IN ('sick_emergency', 'vacation') AND "pto_requests"."status" IN ('pending', 'approved', 'denied', 'cancelled') AND "pto_requests"."start_date" <= "pto_requests"."end_date"

schedule_draft_changes_operation_check.name: schedule_draft_changes_operation_check
schedule_draft_changes_operation_check.value: ("schedule_draft_changes"."operation" = 'delete' AND "schedule_draft_changes"."shift_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("schedule_draft_changes"."operation" = 'upsert' AND "schedule_draft_changes"."employee_id" IS NOT NULL AND "schedule_draft_changes"."date" IS NOT NULL AND "schedule_draft_changes"."start_time" IS NOT NULL AND "schedule_draft_changes"."end_time" IS NOT NULL AND "schedule_draft_changes"."role_name" IS NOT NULL)

time_card_edits_revision_check.name: time_card_edits_revision_check
time_card_edits_revision_check.value: "time_card_edits"."revision" > 0 AND length(trim("time_card_edits"."reason")) > 0 AND json_valid("time_card_edits"."before") AND json_valid("time_card_edits"."after")
